_note: The cross-runtime WIRE CONTRACT — the one shared pin for the modern bridge surface every runtime must advertise identically (constitution Article 8). iOS emits these from Bridge.swift (bridgeVersion + capabilities), Android from Dom/android/VirtualBridge.kt, and both inject them into window.virtual.capabilities / __despiaRuntime.capabilities where OpenSource/Engine/runtime.js (the ONE shared file) gates on them. A coordinated bump MUST land here in the same change, or a runtime's assertion goes red — that is the whole point: this file makes a silent per-platform capabilities drift illegal. The web (TS) runtime joins as runtime #3 per /web/07. Enforced on Android by WireContractTest (:core); the iOS assertion is the flagged d-ios follow-up (Bridge.swift reads this same file in an XCTest / the record-mode lane).
